## [1.5.0](https://github.com/na-x-ril/onlynazril-patches/compare/v1.4.0...v1.5.0) (2026-11-05)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **TikTok/Custom font:** Compose, Lynx and hybrid pages keep TikTok's own text ([b781efe](https://github.com/na-x-ril/onlynazril-patches/commit/b781efec61a6485c1c47526aa37b1cc8193409f9))
* **TikTok/Custom font:** Hybrid pages keep their own font ([c6745a6](https://github.com/na-x-ril/onlynazril-patches/commit/c6745a6db2499309d7445e4b2d7c564750b7b286))

### ✨ New Features

* **TikTok/AMOLED:** Add `AMOLED theme` patch ([b98f05a](https://github.com/na-x-ril/onlynazril-patches/commit/b98f05adfee202908c3e904f4de931cacc83ca04))
* **TikTok:** target 47.7.1 and 47.7.2 and open Tweaks from Home ([821adf9](https://github.com/na-x-ril/onlynazril-patches/commit/821adf9ce4e91cf048f62662253e957f755c1b63))

patches.name: AMOLED code colours
patches.description: Replaces opaque dark surface colours held as constants in code with black. Pulled in by AMOLED theme; does nothing for resources.

patches.name: AMOLED theme
patches.description: Total AMOLED: every colour whose brightest channel is 0x60 or lower becomes black, alpha kept. Borders and controls lose their separation too; repatch to undo.

patches.name: Always @handle · region · post time
patches.description: Shows the @handle, the region and the post time on feed videos and comments, including a video shared into a chat. Each surface and each part has a switch in Tweaks.

patches.name: Copy comments without username
patches.description: Leaves the username out of a copied comment: the clipboard gets the comment's own text. On by default; the switch is in Tweaks.

patches.name: Custom font
patches.description: Answers every resolver TikTok gets one of its own faces from - the native factory, the Compose loader, the asset loader Lynx reads and the WebView interceptor hybrid pages are fed through - so an imported font file replaces TikTok's own text on every surface. The switch and the picker are in Tweaks; off by default, and inert until a font is imported.

patches.name: Download
patches.description: Opens the app's own download for every share sheet and saves the file without the watermark, taking the highest quality variant. Each part has a switch in Tweaks; the feature is off by default.

patches.name: Feed filter
patches.description: Removes ads and promotional-music posts, and videos outside a view- or like-count range, from the feed. Each part has a switch in Tweaks; ads are on by default.

patches.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches.description: Skips the risk-control puzzle TikTok shows while browsing, and lets the app carry on. Account verification (login, SMS or two-factor) is never hidden. On by default; the switch is in Tweaks.

patches.name: Profile background
patches.description: Answers the AB gate that carries the profile background, so a static image or a video can be set on accounts the rollout has not reached. The switch is in Tweaks; the feature is off by default.

patches.name: Tweaks screen
patches.description: Hosts the Tweaks screen, where every other patch in this bundle is switched on or off: the @handle stamp and its surfaces, the region, the post time, the comment copy, the captcha, the feed filter, the download, the profile background and the custom font. Hold the Home tab in the bottom bar to open it.
